title: The lotto - delivery 19
direction: Lou is a practical American shop manager speaking to Johnny at arm's length. No drawl, slurring, mumbling, sleepy tone, exaggerated bass, breathy gravel, theatrical pauses, or stretched final syllables. Read the exact dialogue as one connected thought. text: Devon will be working in the bait and tackle shop, just let him know I sent you.
